title: A Ember for the Veil
author: Ulyana Oyelaran
blurb: Odile Coldharbour, a hedge-witch's runaway apprentice, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must find the door out of a country that no longer exists before the usurper's armies reach the free cities.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
